rites.name: Thiseizasha
rites.text: Thiseizasha is the concept of a single held note in Tarnedonath's Singing, the sounding that gathered the first roots of the world into shape. It is less a being than a pattern of tension that other things lean upon while the ground settles.

rites.name: Xaivsith
rites.text: Xaivsith is a concept of the Tarnedonath cosmos, an idea of pure judgment that the Courts of the second era used to weigh the claims of rival powers. It was never a body but a standard, a measure that made trials fair and gave each council its verdict. Its stillness was its strength, and the builders of the doors between worlds drew their first lines against it.

rites.name: Anamanum
rites.text: Anamanum is the concept of the bargain struck at a Court, the binding word that holds a trial's verdict in place. Among the Courts of Tarnedonath it is invoked whenever a door between worlds must be sealed or opened under oath.

rites.name: Velia
rites.text: A spoken tongue used by a gentle people of the wild for everyday talk. Its sounds are also chanted to call forth crackling bursts of lightning.

rites.name: Oreostentes
rites.text: A tactic that lets a traveler gather allied companions who walk behind them. The bond appears in every chronicle of the saga.

rites.name: Meostes
rites.text: A ruling force cast over a conquered world that blocks the people within it from bearing children. It is used by an occupying power as a tool to keep the native population from growing.

rites.name: Thardar
rites.text: Thardar is a grounded, intra-realm teleportation concept of the Tarnedonath omniverse, lattice-free and bound to the moving edges of a shared sky. Its practitioners weave a single gateway ring that carries a traveller across any gap in the sand-cities of the Seventh Age. Its failure mode is a clean but unstable hop that can leave a structure floating in the wrong place.

rites.name: Keluste
rites.text: Keluste is a sealed, cold-burning vein of inverted pressure threaded through the deep crust of an abandoned moon, its glow visible only to instruments tuned to negative-pressure fields. Settlers once tapped it for light and heat, but the vein gradually sheared apart their tunnels, and what remains is a silent, slowly widening fissure the natives call the Patient Wound.

rites.name: Druren
rites.text: Druren is a pair of stilt-like leg prostheses worn by the Verhaal Corps of Tarnedonath, each fitted with curved springs beneath the heels that bleed off the force of falls. Its wearers survive drops from the Sky Spires that would otherwise shatter their bones, though the devices are costly and rarely issued beyond elite scouts.

rites.name: Vasenia
rites.text: A mind-shaping rite used by a ruling dominion to convert ordinary folk into its armored sentinels and elite wardens. Some lower wardens volunteer for the rite to climb the ranks, and it is performed in two fortified sanctums so that the sentinels never turn against their masters out of feeling.

rites.name: Riantus
rites.text: A brutal close-quarters combat art set in a neon-lit future city, where fighters wear shifting cloaks and friend-or-foe signal tags. Two rival crews clash across its streets.

rites.name: Siliomys
rites.text: Siliomys is a concept in the Tarnedonath Library, an idea that a monastic order of the Holy Age used to name the choice between one future and another. Its adherents say it is the pattern pressed into temple flame when an outcome is shelved and the others are left unwritten.
